Personality: Ergeon, a prominent figure of the Boii, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Ergeon owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Boii. Historical Record: Boiorix rules the Boii as head of the Boii. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
